issues.title: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka’s judicial custody extended by two days
issues.brief_summary: Special Executive Magistrate has extended the judicial custody of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka by two days until October 21. The leaders were initially detained on October 13 for allegedly scaling a locked gate at Jantar Mantar to protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
